summary: The filing is an 8-K by BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2024-5C31, a commercial mortgage ABS issuer, reporting under Item 8.01 a special servicer change for the Colony Square Mortgage Loan, which comprises about 3.4% of the asset pool. Under the BMO 2024-5C8 PSA, Greystone Servicing Company LLC was removed and CWCapital Asset Management LLC appointed successor special servicer, effective July 29, 2026. This is a routine servicer administrative update with no special-situation corporate event, no deal terms, and no strategic implications beyond servicing continuity.
